finding.problem: Switching workspace from an open preview cleared the content but retained preview mode, hiding the new workspace file tree behind an empty preview.
finding.fix: Reset preview mode whenever the workspace canvas refresh has no current file selection.
finding.regression: The new focused case failed before the fix (true !== false); the fixed complete browser suite passes all182 cases.
finding.attachedFolder: web-search-check explicitly includes ui-layout-check as its second folder. Its MAPLE file is correctly accessible under that attached folder heading. Primary-root files retain different content/hashes; chats and Activity remain separate.
